description: Phase 1: Project setup, core types, data files, grid system, and game loop foundation

userStories.title: Project scaffolding and core type system
userStories.description: Initialize Next.js 14 project with TypeScript strict mode and App Router. Install pixi.js, @pixi/react, zustand, immer, uuid, howler. Create the full type system in src/engine/types/index.ts with all enums (TileType, GuestState, RideCategory, ShopCategory, StaffType, Weather, GameSpeed, Season, ToolType) and interfaces (Tile, GameDate, Ride, RideDefinition, Shop, ShopDefinition, Guest, Staff, District, FinancialReport, GameState). Create the directory structure: src/engine/core/, src/engine/simulation/, src/engine/world/, src/engine/types/, src/renderer/layers/, src/ui/, src/state/, src/data/, src/assets/. Empty placeholder files with TODO comments where needed.
acceptanceCriteria: Next.js 14 project initializes with TypeScript strict mode
All packages installed: pixi.js @pixi/react zustand immer uuid howler
src/engine/types/index.ts contains all enums and interfaces from the build plan
Directory structure matches the architecture spec
npm run build passes with zero TypeScript errors
userStories.notes: Refer to hk-theme-park-tycoon-build-plan.md for the complete type definitions and architecture layout.

userStories.title: Game data files (rides, shops, districts)
userStories.description: Create src/data/rides.json with 12 HK-themed ride definitions (Dragon Coaster, Junk Boat Cruise, Peak Tram Drop Tower, Dim Sum Spinner, Neon Night Flyer, Temple Garden Train, Harbour Ferris Wheel, Typhoon Twister, Bamboo Scaffold Climb, Lion Dance Carousel, Star Ferry Splash, Kowloon Walled City Maze). Create src/data/shops.json with 8 shops (Dai Pai Dong, Egg Waffle Stand, Milk Tea Shop, Souvenir Pagoda, Bubble Tea Bar, Noodle House, Ice Cream Junk, First Aid Station). Create src/data/districts.json with 6 HK districts (Mong Kok Market as starter, Tsim Sha Tsui Waterfront, Lantau Highlands, Central Business District, Aberdeen Fishing Village, Kowloon Peak). All data must conform to the TypeScript interfaces defined in US-001.
acceptanceCriteria: rides.json has 12 entries matching RideDefinition interface
shops.json has 8 entries matching ShopDefinition interface
districts.json has 6 entries matching District interface
Mong Kok Market is free and unlocked by default
npm run build passes with zero TypeScript errors
userStories.notes: See build plan for exact stats, costs, footprints, and descriptions for each item.

userStories.title: Grid system and tile management
userStories.description: Build src/engine/world/Grid.ts - Grid class with: constructor(width, height) creating 2D Tile array initialized to EMPTY; getTile(x,y) with bounds checking; setTile(x,y,type); canPlaceEntity(x,y,w,h) checking all tiles in footprint are EMPTY and buildable; placeEntity(entityId,tiles[]) marking tiles; removeEntity(entityId) clearing tiles; getNeighbors(x,y) returning adjacent walkable tiles; calculateSceneryScore(x,y,radius) counting decorations nearby. Include unit tests.
acceptanceCriteria: Grid class creates correct 2D tile array
canPlaceEntity properly validates footprint boundaries and buildability
placeEntity and removeEntity correctly update tile states
getNeighbors returns only valid, walkable adjacent tiles
calculateSceneryScore counts decorations within given radius
npm run build passes with zero TypeScript errors

userStories.title: A* pathfinding with caching
userStories.description: Build src/engine/world/Pathfinder.ts - Pathfinder class with: findPath(grid, startX, startY, endX, endY) returning {x,y}[] using A* on PATH tiles with Manhattan distance heuristic. Add path caching: cache key = 'startX,startY-endX,endY', invalidate cache when grid changes. Add maxIterations limit (2000) to prevent browser freezing. Return empty array if no path found.
acceptanceCriteria: A* pathfinding finds shortest path on PATH tiles
Returns empty array when no path exists
Path cache stores and returns cached results
Cache invalidates when grid is modified
maxIterations prevents infinite loops
npm run build passes with zero TypeScript errors

userStories.title: EventBus and GameLoop core
userStories.description: Build src/engine/core/EventBus.ts - typed pub/sub event system with on(event, callback), off(event, callback), emit(event, data). Define game event types: GUEST_SPAWNED, GUEST_LEFT, RIDE_BROKEN, RIDE_FIXED, MONEY_CHANGED, MONTH_END, YEAR_END, WEATHER_CHANGED, DISTRICT_UNLOCKED. Build src/engine/core/GameLoop.ts - GameLoop class using requestAnimationFrame. Manages tick accumulation with speed multiplier (PAUSED=0, NORMAL=1, FAST=2, ULTRA=4). Calls registered update callbacks each tick. Exposes start(), stop(), setSpeed(), getCurrentTick().
acceptanceCriteria: EventBus correctly subscribes, unsubscribes, and emits typed events
GameLoop runs at correct tick rates per speed setting
PAUSED speed produces zero ticks
GameLoop properly accumulates and dispatches ticks
start() and stop() correctly control the loop
npm run build passes with zero TypeScript errors

userStories.title: Zustand game store and save manager
userStories.description: Build src/state/gameStore.ts - Zustand store with immer middleware containing the full GameState. Include actions: initializeGame(parkName), placePath(x,y), placeRide(definitionId,x,y,rotation), placeShop(definitionId,x,y), demolish(x,y), setSpeed(speed), setTool(tool), unlockDistrict(districtId). Build src/state/saveManager.ts - IndexedDB save/load with saveGame() serializing state and loadGame() restoring it. Auto-save every 5 minutes of game time.

userStories.title: Economy manager and financial reports
userStories.description: Build src/engine/simulation/EconomyManager.ts. Tracks cash, revenue streams (rides, shops, entrance fees), expenses (staff wages, ride maintenance, loan interest). Implements: processMonthEnd() generating FinancialReport, takeLoan(amount) with 10% annual interest, repayLoan(amount), calculateRideValue(ride) using the adapted OpenRCT2 formula with ride-type multipliers. Emit MONEY_CHANGED and MONTH_END events.
acceptanceCriteria: Monthly financial reports accurately sum all revenue and expense categories
Loan system correctly applies interest monthly
Ride value formula uses correct multipliers per ride category
MONEY_CHANGED fires on any cash transaction
MONTH_END fires with completed FinancialReport
npm run build passes with zero TypeScript errors
userStories.notes: Ride value formula: rideValue = ((excitement * excitementMultiplier * 32) >> 15) + ((intensity * intensityMultiplier * 32) >> 15) + ((nausea * nauseaMultiplier * 32) >> 15)

userStories.title: Guest AI state machine and needs system
userStories.description: Build src/engine/simulation/GuestManager.ts. Guest spawning based on park rating and time. Guest state machine: ENTERING->WALKING->QUEUING->RIDING->WALKING->... with SHOPPING/EATING/SITTING branches. Needs-based decision making: hunger/thirst/nausea/energy drive behavior. Happiness system: happinessTarget adjusts based on experiences, actual happiness gravitates toward target. Guest pathfinding to chosen targets. Thought bubbles for current need ('I'm hungry!', 'What a great ride!'). Guests leave when cash runs out, energy depleted, or happiness too low.
acceptanceCriteria: Guests spawn at entrance at rate proportional to park rating
State machine transitions correctly between all states
Needs (hunger, thirst, etc.) increase over time and drive decisions
Happiness gravitates toward happinessTarget
Guests pathfind to rides, shops, and exits
Guests leave park under correct exit conditions
npm run build passes with zero TypeScript errors
userStories.notes: Keep guest count reasonable for browser performance. Cap at ~200 active guests initially.

userStories.title: Ride manager with queues and breakdowns
userStories.description: Build src/engine/simulation/RideManager.ts. Manages ride operations: queue processing (guests join queue, wait, board, ride for rideDurationTicks, exit), capacity enforcement. Ride ratings modified by: scenery within 5 tiles (+0.4 excitement per decoration), proximity to other rides, age/novelty decay, maintenance level. Breakdown system: random chance per month based on ride breakdownChance, broken rides close until mechanic arrives. Track totalCustomers and totalRevenue per ride.
acceptanceCriteria: Guests queue and board rides respecting capacity limits
Ride duration ticks are respected before guests exit
Scenery proximity modifies excitement rating
Ride novelty decays with age (monthsOld)
Breakdowns occur randomly and close the ride
Revenue tracking per ride is accurate
npm run build passes with zero TypeScript errors

userStories.title: PixiJS renderer with isometric camera
userStories.description: Build the rendering layer: src/renderer/GameCanvas.tsx wrapping PIXI.Application in a React component. src/renderer/Camera.ts with pan (click-drag), zoom (scroll wheel, 0.5x-3x range), smooth interpolation. src/renderer/IsometricUtils.ts with screenToGrid and gridToScreen transforms for 2:1 isometric. src/renderer/layers/TerrainLayer.ts rendering ground tiles with colored rectangles (green=empty, gray=path, blue=water). src/renderer/layers/BuildingLayer.ts rendering rides and shops as colored footprint rectangles with name labels. Build src/app/game/page.tsx as the main game page mounting the canvas.
acceptanceCriteria: PixiJS canvas renders and fills the game page
Camera pan works with click-drag
Camera zoom works with scroll wheel within 0.5x-3x range
Isometric coordinate transforms are correct (screen<->grid)
Terrain tiles render with distinct colors per type
Rides and shops render as labeled colored rectangles
npm run build passes with zero TypeScript errors
Verify in browser: canvas renders, camera controls work
userStories.notes: Use placeholder colored rectangles for all sprites initially. Proper art comes later.

userStories.title: UI overlay - toolbar, top bar, and info panel

userStories.title: Build mode - placing paths, rides, and shops
userStories.description: Implement interactive build mode: when Path tool selected, clicking grid tiles places PATH tiles and updates renderer. When Ride tool selected, show ride picker panel with all 12 rides from data, clicking one shows a ghost footprint following the cursor, click to place (if canPlaceEntity passes), right-click or R to rotate. When Shop tool selected, similar picker and placement. Demolish tool removes entities and resets tiles. Deduct costs from player money. Play placement sound effect. Wire everything through the Zustand store actions.
